question: How do cold discovery/collection/linear algebra/recovery costs change with twist constructors and matched known-equation compression?

claims.text: All admitted counter and finite curve/map/fiber/scalar results are independently checked.
Measure paired full/compressed cold and matrix Ir with identical equations and verified target outcomes; keep all failed DLP attempts.
Measure matched ordinary/maximal-twist total Ir, same alpha/compression/workload; all failures retained.
Finite counted-software cohort only; no calibrated GAE, clock, confidence, global-fastest, asymptotic, novelty or NIST claim.

arms.description: One frozen native worker containing IC and DLP references, with actual resident GP backend charged.
Independent GP group/Velu/matrix/kernel/point verification and native raw-counter audit.
First six Q=2G known-answer and identical fresh-process nuisance controls, same worker.

primary.name: Cold one-target guest instructions
primary.definition: Sum all exclusive native and actual resident-GP ROI intervals from setup to source verification; no launch/input/fixture/result-file work.

secondary.definition: Exact maximum of the25ms RSS samples for resource guard, with unmeasured between-sample peaks; not an exact process high-water mark.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly4749 planned cells,6 positive/AA first,120s per cell,21600s global,4GiB sampled RSS and1.5GB compressed raw tree. Counter/control failure stops; no silent retry, all unstarted cases retained.

decision_rule.text: Admit only source-bound, independently replayed exact counters/outcomes. Report matched cold and stage ratios without removing failed cases or claiming population generality.
decision_rule.statistic: Paired cold Ir, matrix Ir separately, scalar recovery/status counts, all five matched references; Ir/sqrt(r) without GAE conversion.
decision_rule.interval: Observed case/three-process ranges only, no confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: full/compressed and ordinary/twist ratios; both require completed verified DLPs, unsuccessful statuses remain explicit.

graphs: All outcome counts, per-phase cost, matched compression/family/reference ratios, explicit failure denominators.

Using heldout DLP outcomes to size/select
